DEPLOYER.purpose: deploys contracts, registers the demo merchant identity

OWNER.purpose: human owner: root key of the smart account, owns the pass NFTs, revokes and refunds

MERCHANT.purpose: API seller: receives tUSD8, submits batch claims

AGENT_A.purpose: agent A session key: opens passes inside the policy, signs vouchers

AGENT_B.purpose: agent B session key: takes over a pass after reassignment

RELAYER.purpose: hosted playground relayer: pays gas for one-signature pass opening (keep lightly funded)
